payload.posture: Read Ephesians 5:1–14 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the letter links a Kingdom inheritance warning with sexual immorality, impurity, covetousness, thanksgiving, and walking as children of light. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
